trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one unlocks itself the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Press estimates put a full platinum run at roughly 200 hours, so treat this as the finish line of the roadmap, not a trophy you chase directly.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It pops as you play the story — unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a beat late. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here Jason and Lucia are both playable, and you can call either one in as a partner — that unlocks the partner trophies later on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. When Race Against Yago appears in this chapter, do it the moment you see it — it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults unlock near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — that is where Maximum Withdrawal begins.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable; it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable; it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable; it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable; it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown — VCIA is Vice City International Airport. Unmissable; it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable; it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The 35-task checklist only opens after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but work done earlier still counts. Beyond this trophy's own counts, 100% also needs 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250: 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — PSN tracks 9 types. Races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, gym training and more all count as types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. Check your progress per challenge in-game and work the ones you are missing.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Keep a note of which locations are done — the PSN counter reads 0/14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 DIFFERENT races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Street races, drone races and other race types all feed the PSN 0/20 counter.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You can do this from Chapter 1 — it was already at 1.16% earned on Exophase at launch, so it is very doable early.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Doable from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — it is Lucia-only. It stays available after the credits, and it does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks; it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It stays available after the credits, and it does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, Yago's street-racing strand) is time-sensitive — do it the moment it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do NOT count (they have their own trophies), so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive: save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — it is Jason-only. It stays available after the credits, and it does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: THE ONLY MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after Chapter 1. No mission replay, no New Game Plus.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (PSN 0/18); spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE RISK: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Output Lag notes it is not confirmed the trophy strictly needs the balcony spot — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — his questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; track your sets in the in-game collection menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 locations. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it (Whip It Good) — scan traffic as you drive.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges (listed under Progress > Challenges). There are 80 in total and 100% needs 70; many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need Jason and Lucia together (from Chapter 2 — call your partner in). Bank vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this too. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it — scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — slow-motion aim, press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies (guards at an illegal operation work well) and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. Delayed pop: fly about 1 km away from the airport. Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if spotted, reload.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone — bring your partner. Vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida (PSN 0/52). Exploration is tracked per area in-game; mop up unvisited areas after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. 100% needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint. This guide does not invent a location or step. The description suggests a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach; treat that as reading the description, not as a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint. This guide does not invent a showroom, a vehicle or a method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe (blow it open with a Sticky Bomb). Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later — not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength — reported, not fully confirmed, so treat it as a strong lead rather than a certainty. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there; the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (PSN 0/500). Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. PowerPyx and GTABase both say the 'Irredeemable' Criminal Profile state is permanent — read a Criminal Profile guide before a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint. This guide does not invent a trigger. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something; take that as reading the description, not as a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint. The description suggests witnessing something strange or unexplained; take that as reading the description, not as a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the exact trigger is unconfirmed. The description itself names the act: bowl someone over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon while driving past — the guide can explain that much, but the precise trigger is still unverified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (cumulative). Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling to contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative, every kind of shop).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space — buy garages first and register cheap cars.
